segments.description: Produces and sells liquefied natural gas from its Liquefaction Projects to customers worldwide under long-term contracts and short-term or spot sales.
segments.evidence: LNG produced by the Liquefaction Projects that is not contracted under long-term contracts is available for Cheniere Marketing, our integrated marketing function, to sell in the global market under spot sales or other short-term agreements.
